summary: Backend-only test pass for Conexia CLM v2 (iteration 3). Re-authored /app/backend/tests/test_conexia_clm.py to cover every item in the review request: email/password register+login+locale, bcrypt hashing (password_hash never returned), seed v2 with all 6 categories (bienes, obras, servicios_no_consultoria, consultor_individual, firma_consultora, acuerdo_marco) plus sub-collections (risks/payments/esf_items), GET /contracts?category=obras filter, contract detail includes new fields (contract_number/consultant/product/scheduled_date/delivery_date/pay_pct/observations/category/risks/modifications/payments/esf_items), POST risks/modifications/payments/esf endpoints + paid-payment increments executed_value, sign endpoint now correctly rejects draft contracts with 400 and only signs after workflow approval, plus regression on dashboard (kpis+alerts+recent+by_category), workflow rollup, addenda, evidence, and /ai/analyze. Result: 26/26 passing on the public preview URL https://contract-forge-35.preview.emergentagent.com. No backend bugs detected. AI analyze hits anthropic claude-sonnet-4-6 via emergentintegrations and returns valid JSON.

minor.issue: Pydantic EmailStr (email-validator) rejects special-use TLDs (.test, .example, .invalid, .localhost) with HTTP 422 before the custom 400/401 paths run. Not a bug per se, but document that valid public TLDs are required in tests/clients.

action_items: (Optional) Document in API spec that EmailStr rejects reserved TLDs (.test/.example/.invalid/.localhost) → 422; clients should use real-looking domains.

(Optional) Consider returning 401 instead of 422 when /api/auth/login is called with a syntactically invalid email, to keep the error surface uniform for credential failures. Currently invalid format yields 422 while wrong password/unknown user yields 401.
critical_code_review_comments: bcrypt: hash_password uses bcrypt.gensalt(rounds=12) — strong; verify_password swallows all exceptions and returns False, which is safe.
doc_clean correctly strips both _id and password_hash from every API response, including nested dicts/lists — confirmed via TestPasswordAuth assertions.

Seed is idempotent (count_documents > 0 → skipped). Good for re-runs, but means changing SAMPLES does not refresh DB unless contracts collection is cleared. Consider a /api/seed?force=true flag for dev convenience.
POST /api/contracts/{id}/sign now enforces status ∈ (approved, signed, active) → 400 otherwise. Matches review requirement.
POST /api/contracts/{id}/payments with status='paid' performs $inc on executed_value AFTER the $push — confirmed sequence is correct and atomic per write.
server.py is 849 lines — approaching the 700-line guideline. Consider splitting auth/contracts/submodules/ai into routers.
AI endpoint hard-codes provider/model 'anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-6' — fine for MVP, but consider env override.
/auth/locale accepts a raw dict payload; would be cleaner as a typed pydantic LocaleRequest.

All 14 review-request items verified explicitly: register success+409+400, login success+401, locale='en' persistence + invalid 400, seed 6 categories with risks/payments/esf, category=obras filter, contract detail new fields, POST risks/modifications/payments(paid→exec)/esf each adding timeline events, sign 400 on draft + 200 after approval, and full regression on dashboard/workflow/addenda/evidence/ai.
